description: FindTalent is a candidate-sourcing platform that helps recruiters find qualified candidates.

tools.name: candidates_export
tools.description: Export a list of candidates to CSV or JSON format. The candidate IDs must be provided in the request body. Required: candidateIds, format (default: csv). Optional: fields. Returns array of CandidateProfile.

params.name: candidateIds
params.description: List of candidate IDs to export

params.name: fields
params.description: Specific fields to include in the export. If not specified, all available fields are included.

tools.name: candidates_get
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific candidate by ID. Required: candidateId. Returns the CandidateProfile.

tools.name: candidates_search
tools.description: Search for candidates based on criteria like job title, company, location, and keywords. Returns a list of candidate profiles with basic information. Optional: company, keywords, limit (default: 20) (plus 4 more).

params.name: location
params.description: Filter by location (city, state, or country)

tools.name: findtalent-search_get-history
tools.description: Retrieve the user's recent search history. Optional: limit (default: 20). Returns array of SearchHistoryEntry.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of history entries to return
